ideas.title: Following the Money in Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the flow of money in Medicaid fraud cases, including the Feeding Our Future case
questions: How did the defendants in the Feeding Our Future case use the fraudulent funds?
Are there any other cases of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
ideas.insight: By following the money, we may be able to identify patterns and connections between different cases of Medicaid fraud. This could lead to a larger investigation and potentially uncover more widespread corruption.
